title: Boulevardier Fruit Cup From Azo Drinks
ldName: Boulevardier Fruit Cup From Azo Drinks
ldInstructionsRaw: Add all of the ingredients, except the tonic water, to a glass with ice. Top with tonic water. Garnish.

Cucumber SyrupAdd the water and cucumber to a saucepan and let it boil for 3 to 5 minutes over medium heat. Add the sugar and stir until it dissolves. Strain and allow to cool. Will keep in the refrigerator for 1 week.
